description: Published maritime and logistics statistics for the Economics bundle's optional logistics feature: UN/LOCODE port identities per code-list release, UNCTADstat port calls, liner shipping connectivity, container port throughput and merchant fleet series, Eurostat maritime goods by port, country and published port-to-partner route, and the one freight index cleared as openly licensed (BLS PPI deep sea freight). Values as published with release vintages; commercial freight indices are excluded by licence decision; no forecasting.

license.redistribution: free reuse with attribution to UNECE (operator must confirm)

sources.scope: UN/LOCODE port-function entries of Germany and the Netherlands from one declared code-list release (operator must verify the release file name, the CSV part and the column order)
sources.temporal_semantics: the declared release version and publication date; changed entries add revisions and codes absent from a later release of the same countries are marked removed
sources.update_cadence: about twice a year (one release version per declaration)
